habitat: Singly or in pairs at dams, pans and quiet rivers with fringing reed beds. It swims in open water and also feeds in vleis and marshland.
summary: A common resident. Larger than Lesser Moorhen, with a bright red bill and a rounded frontal shield. The bill tip and the legs are yellow. The legs are yellow or greenish yellow, with a red band around the tibia. The flank feathers are white. The immature is browner. The call is a high-pitched descending kr-rrrrk. The Kemp name Moorhen and the code VB were left unchanged.

similar.note: Lesser Moorhen is smaller, with a mostly yellow bill and red only on the culmen and pointed shield. It lacks the red tibial rings.
